summary: BTCS Labs Inc. filed an 8-K reporting issuance of a $25,000 unsecured promissory note to its CEO Charles Allen, who loaned that amount to the company. The note bears 6% annual interest, compounded annually, maturing on December 31, 2030, or earlier upon a board change; default triggers 15% interest after a five-day cure. The note is non-convertible and prepayable without penalty. This is a routine related-party financing agreement, not a special situation.
